findings.claim: The diff still ships a terminal COMPLETE/DONE projection with consumed completion counters while acceptance task 10 remains open and gated, so any consumer of the legacy phase projection can archive or advance on a false completion record.
findings.evidence: progress.json sets "implementation_status": "COMPLETE", "status": "DONE", "changes_completed": 3, "implementation_completed": 3, and "tasks_done": 6 of 10; tasks.md still shows "[ ] 10 ... (IN_PROGRESS)"; the acceptance criterion says task 10 includes "artifact-only adversarial review; verify and archive only after both gates pass"; control-plane-correction.json admits the compatibility ledger is "known-stale-authoritative-runtime-compatibility-ledger" at sourceRevision 338 rather than corrected.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an enforced archive/verify guard that refuses to proceed when progress.json/tasks.md lag the canonical revision or when a change is DONE with open gated tasks; if the signed API cannot repair the legacy ledger, remove it from automation inputs or emit an explicit machine-readable stale flag rather than relying on prose.

findings.claim: A new public package export subpath is added, but the packet only proves runtime named exports are unchanged and does not show any export-map/package-contract ledger synchronization for that new public surface.
findings.evidence: package.json adds "./devtools/fixtures/time-travel-v1.json": { "default": "./fixtures/devtools/time-travel-v1.json" }; verification.md says only "128 unchanged root exports and 7 unchanged optional ./devtools exports" matching core-library-exports.json; acceptance task 10 requires synchronizing "public API and skills ledgers" before verify/archive.
findings.suggested_fix: Refresh the relevant exports/package-contract ledger for the new JSON subpath, or add an explicit verified rule that fixture JSON subpaths are intentionally outside the runtime-export ledger and are covered by package payload validation.

findings.claim: The current refiner artifact still contains machine-readable checkpoint files whose embedded terminate timestamp contradicts state.json, while reflection.json continues to claim exact evidence traceability.
findings.evidence: current checkpoints/45bed4e9.json, 9100ef56.json, and f0578e81.json embed iteration_history[0] "decision": "terminate", "timestamp": "2026-08-29T20:15:30Z"; current state.json records the same decision at "2026-08-29T20:20:06Z"; reflection.json says deterministic validation passes with "exact evidence traceability" and only prose in decisions.md marks the checkpoints as stale mirrors.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove stale checkpoint files from the current artifact, regenerate them from the corrected final state, or add an explicit machine-readable authority/stale marker so auditors and tooling do not parse them as chronological evidence.

findings.claim: The change manifest is not a reliable file inventory: it lists directories for the refiner artifact/history trees and omits files.txt itself while the diff adds many individual files under those trees.
findings.evidence: files.txt contains entries such as ".refiner/artifacts/v3-devtools-time-travel-archive-qa" and ".refiner/history/v3-devtools-time-travel-archive-qa/2026-08-29_20-20-25Z" rather than the added state.json/checkpoints/decisions/reflection files, and its first entry is ".kbd-orchestrator/changes/v3-devtools-time-travel" rather than ".kbd-orchestrator/changes/v3-devtools-time-travel/files.txt".
findings.suggested_fix: Generate files.txt as an exhaustive file list including the manifest itself, or rename/document it as a directory-scope index so verification does not treat it as complete file evidence.
